data.title: 圣路易斯 · 晨曦套房的露肩军服优雅早安
data.description: 奢华高层套房主卧被初升的朝阳染上一层柔和的金辉。圣路易斯坐在床沿，身穿标志性的白蓝联邦露肩军官制服。短款深蓝外套轻挽在圆润的香肩两侧，白色百褶短裙衬托出匀称修长的双腿。她双手交叠伸了个舒缓的懒腰，天蓝色长发在晨风中微扬，眼波流转间尽显成熟舰娘特有的端庄与娇媚。
data.location: sunlit penthouse master bed with silk sheets
data.action: sitting on edge of bed stretching gracefully in off-shoulder blue naval uniform jacket and white pleated skirt, bare shoulders, collarbone, black thighhighs, long blue hair loose, warm morning sunlight, enchanting affectionate smile
data.lighting: warm golden morning sunbeams streaming through sheer drapes
data.mood: intimate morning luxury, effortless sultry naval elegance
data.promptProse: Sitting on the edge of a sunlit hotel bed, St. Louis stretches in her signature off-shoulder Eagle Union naval uniform jacket and pleated skirt. Morning light illuminates her bare shoulders and flowing blue hair as she smiles with sultry charm.
data.animaCaption: St. Louis stretching on a hotel bed in her off-shoulder naval uniform in warm morning light.
